title: Create Table [Syntax and TEXT/INT/FLOAT(or REAL)]
description:
Now, it is time for you to make your own tables!
To create a table in SQL, you use 
```sql
CREATE TABLE table_name (
    field_name FIELD_TYPE,
    field_name FIELD_TYPE,......
    field_name FIELD_TYPE
);
```
There are 3 main types in SQL, TEXT (text), INT(whole number) and FLOAT(decimal number).

---
## Assignment:
Create a table instances with fields id, name, status, and uptime with types INT, TEXT, TEXT, and FLOAT.
runHarness: INSERT INTO instances (id, name, status, uptime) VALUES (1, 'BWS-server', 'running', 12.5),(2, 'riku', 'creating-a-sidequest', 99.99),(3, 'chaos', 'locked-up', 9999999.99);SELECT * FROM instances;
expectedOutput:
id | name | status | uptime
1 | BWS-server | running | 12.5
2 | riku | creating-a-sidequest | 99.99
3 | chaos | locked-up | 9999999.99
